core_obligations: Retain the complete explicit hard-polynomial construction and complexity/rank guarantee.
Collapse auxiliary-variable layers and decompose each ordered branching program into low-width products.
Bound relative rank under random words and use a union bound against every summand.
Retain both complete degree-regime optimizations as one lower-bound family, not separate counts.
difficulty_reason: The authors compare relative rank under a random variable partition with product decompositions of ordered ABPs, controlling all summands despite different orderings. The combined support/width tradeoff gives a nonroutine lower-bound family in low and high degree regimes; these regimes are grouped into one counted item.
